newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Union Miniere rallies on zinc price.
newsitem.headline: Union Miniere rallies on zinc price.

text.p: Shares in Belgian non-ferrous metals producer Union Miniere jumped 4.05 percent in early trade on Thursday on the back of rising zinc prices and investors' enthusiasm for a stock which had lagged recent bourse rises.
"Union Miniere is up because of zinc prices, a lot of people were waiting on the sidelines and yesterday they started to get into the stock," said analyst Gert De Mesure at Bank Delen.
By 1025 GMT the share was up 4.05 percent at 2,310 francs while all other Bel-20 shares were down.
Another dealer said the share was also gaining ground because it had lagged other leading Belgian stocks with investors now shopping around for underperforming stocks.
